en.headline: Election Committee subsector polls open today from 9am to 6pm
en.dek: 856 candidates contest 723 seats across 31 subsectors at five ordinary polling stations; voters must bring original HKID.
body: The 2026 Election Committee Subsector Ordinary Elections take place today, with polling from 9am to 6pm.

According to the Registration and Electoral Office, 856 candidates are contesting 723 seats in 31 subsectors. Five ordinary polling stations are open at Harbour Road Sports Centre, Kowloon Park Sports Centre, Tsuen Wan Sports Centre, Tiu Keng Leng Sports Centre and Che Kung Temple Sports Centre. Dedicated stations are at Happy Valley Police Station and Shek Pik Prison.

Voters and authorised representatives must present the original of their valid Hong Kong identity card at their designated station as shown on their poll card. The Electronic Poll Register System will be used to issue ballot papers. Counting will take place at the Central Counting Station in the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre.

zh.headline: 選委會界別分組選舉今日舉行 投票時間上午九時至下午六時
zh.dek: 856名候選人競逐31個界別分組723個席位，五個一般投票站開放，投票人須帶備香港身份證正本。
body: 二○二六年選舉委員會界別分組一般選舉今日舉行，投票時間由上午九時至下午六時。
選舉事務處表示，856名候選人競逐31個界別分組的723個席位。五個一般投票站分別設於港灣道體育館、九龍公園體育館、荃灣體育館、調景嶺體育館及車公廟體育館。另設兩個專用投票站，位於跑馬地警署及石壁監獄。
投票人或獲授權代表須依照投票通知卡指示，帶同有效香港身份證正本前往獲編配的投票站。一般投票站使用電子選民登記冊系統發出選票。點票工作將在香港會議展覽中心的中央點票站進行。
